title: Microsoft Hits $92.3B Record Quarter as Cloud Growth Speeds Up
dek: AI demand pushed Microsoft Cloud growth to 30% as capital spending hit a record.
caption:
Microsoft just posted its tenth straight record quarter, and AI is the reason 📈

For its fiscal Q1 2027, Microsoft reported $92.3 billion in revenue, up 19%. Microsoft Cloud, which includes Azure and Microsoft 365, brought in $63.9 billion, with growth speeding up to 30%. The commercial backlog of signed future contracts jumped 73% to $677 billion, much of it tied to AI labs like OpenAI and Anthropic buying computing power.

The catch is cost. Capital spending on data centers and chips topped $45.2 billion, another record. Meanwhile, Windows device revenue fell 22%, so Microsoft's focus is clearly on cloud and AI agents.

We're tracking this at AI Parabellum. The big question now: can cloud growth stay near 30% while the AI buildout bill keeps climbing?
